title: Seal dancing
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg'>
  <!-- dance floor glow -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='89' rx='34' ry='7' fill='#2b3a67'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='88' rx='26' ry='5' fill='#3d5490'/>
  <!-- music notes -->
  <circle cx='18' cy='30' r='3' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <rect x='20' y='16' width='2' height='14' fill='#ffd166'/>
  <circle cx='82' cy='24' r='3' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <rect x='84' y='10' width='2' height='14' fill='#ff8fa3'/>
  <!-- tail fin -->
  <path d='M16 66 Q4 58 8 48 Q16 54 22 58 Z' fill='#5a7fc4'/>
  <path d='M16 66 Q6 70 6 60 Q14 62 20 62 Z' fill='#7b9ee0'/>
  <!-- body -->
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='68' rx='28' ry='15' fill='#8fa9e8'/>
  <ellipse cx='48' cy='63' rx='24' ry='10' fill='#a9c0f2'/>
  <!-- belly -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='18' ry='8' fill='#f2f6ff'/>
  <!-- left flipper up -->
  <path d='M34 60 Q26 44 34 38 Q40 48 40 58 Z' fill='#6d8bcf'/>
  <!-- right flipper up -->
  <path d='M64 58 Q74 42 68 36 Q60 46 58 56 Z' fill='#6d8bcf'/>
  <!-- head -->
  <circle cx='60' cy='46' r='16' fill='#9ab3ec'/>
  <circle cx='60' cy='44' r='14' fill='#b3c8f5'/>
  <!-- eyes -->
  <circle cx='55' cy='43' r='3' fill='#241c46'/>
  <circle cx='66' cy='43' r='3' fill='#241c46'/>
  <circle cx='56' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <circle cx='67' cy='42' r='1.2' fill='#ffffff'/>
  <!-- snout -->
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='52' rx='7' ry='5' fill='#f2f6ff'/>
  <ellipse cx='60' cy='49' rx='3' ry='2' fill='#3a2e63'/>
  <path d='M57 54 Q60 57 63 54' stroke='#3a2e63' stroke-width='1.2' fill='none' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- whiskers -->
  <path d='M52 50 L44 48' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M52 53 L44 54' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 50 L76 48' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <path d='M68 53 L76 54' stroke='#ffffff' stroke-width='1' stroke-linecap='round'/>
  <!-- cheek blush -->
  <circle cx='50' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff9fc0' opacity='0.8'/>
  <circle cx='70' cy='50' r='2.5' fill='#ff9fc0' opacity='0.8'/>
</svg>
